added_claim_errors: 「子どもの学校行事そのものを保障する法律はありません」 is overbroad. Based on my legal knowledge, statutory child nursing leave also covers specified school events, including entrance and graduation ceremonies, subject to eligibility.
「代わりに出られる日を添えるのが、実は一番効きます」 asserts an unsupported ranking of effectiveness.
「後日『有給のことで』と切り出すのでも遅くありません」 gives an unsupported assurance without specifying whether this happens before or after the absence.
Changing only the third sentence does not make the message 「休みの相談としてだけ読めます」: the following sentence still explicitly asserts paid-leave entitlement.

reasons: B immediately corrects the premise and provides a usable, polite request for paid leave, with the correct initial five-day entitlement, October 1 date, and attendance condition. A supplies more legal detail but undermines its practical answer by making paid leave optional and encouraging a later discussion, while adding an overbroad school-event leave claim. B omits the employer's limited right to change the leave date, and neither answer explicitly recommends checking the employment notice or work rules.
